title: An Euler tour of the full permutation overlap graph that no cyclic word realizes: a refutation of Hurlbert's ordering conjecture for universal cycles of permutations
beyond_target: accepted after the campaign target of 40 was reached (additional result #49 toward 60)
exact_endpoint: MathDB356266.conjecture_false : ¬ MathDB356266.Conjecture, where Conjecture := for all n N and every t : Fin (N+1) -> Fin (n+1) -> Fin (n+1) with EulerOrdering t (every row a permutation, rows distinct, every permutation occurring, every cyclic consecutive pair overlapping after reduction) there are K and a cyclic word w : Fin (N+1) -> Fin K whose windows realize t; also MathDB356266.conjectureLinear_false for words over an arbitrary linear order
scope: Hurlbert's ordering conjecture (Kirsch-Sibley-Sprangel Conjecture 6.3; Hurlbert 1990; the Chung-Diaconis-Graham 1992 belief) is false at n = 4: an explicit Euler tour of the clustered overlap graph O(4) is realized by no cyclic word over any linearly ordered alphabet
source_targets: Hurlbert 1990 thesis Conjecture 3.1.3 and Chung-Diaconis-Graham 1992 Section 4 (as cited)
formalization_lanes: expanded-corpus-r234 (core certificate) and hurlbert-formal-r1 (literal endpoints and control; 5 modules)

root_independent_check: hurlbert-root-check-r1/check.py: the 24 rows are S_4, all cyclic overlaps hold, the forced-comparison digraph contains the strict cycle 2-5-8-10-13-15-18-20-23-2

substantive_reason: It refutes a well-known conjecture on universal cycles for permutations (Hurlbert 1990; believed by Chung-Diaconis-Graham 1992; stated as open in two 2022 papers) for the full permutation graph, with an explicit Euler tour of O(4) and a nine-inequality cyclic certificate; it also shows, via the source's correspondence, that graph universal cycles achieve orders no universal cycle can. The comparison-cycle mechanism is classical (CDG, Albert-West); the full-S_n obstruction is new as far as the bounded screen shows.
